title: tecoma grandiflora
intro: Tecoma grandiflora, commonly known as Yellow Elder or Trumpet Tree, is a flowering plant native to Central and South America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, aiding in digestion, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tecoma grandiflora include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
